dish: Classic lagers, saisons and Schwarzbier with grilled cheese on house-made focaccia, served in pews turned booths
w: Brewery and scratch kitchen (2021) filling a 9,000-sq-ft 1858 church in Kent's West River neighborhood, run by cicerone/beer judge Jennifer Herman with Ryan and Bridget Tipton. Cleveland Magazine calls it worth a foodie trip; covered by The Portager at opening and by the Beacon Journal's 2025 brewery-industry story.

dish: Diner breakfast platters, omelets, waffles and biscuits and gravy at a four-stool counter
w: 51-seat diner (late 2023) in Ravenna's Buckeye Mall that revives the name of the Horseshoe Diner that stood beside the Hotel Ravenna from the 1940s to the '60s. Featured by The Portager ('After 60 years, there's a new Horseshoe Diner') and the Record-Courier ('folksy charm').
